business_summary: Hatsuho Shouji Co.,Ltd. trades in steel and construction materials in Japan. The company offers interior building materials, such as steel ceiling framing, steel wall base, gypsum board, glass wool, and residential insulation materials, as well as ceiling, non-combustible board, rock wool sound-absorbing panels, bis, suspension bolts, ceiling access and underfloor inspection hatch, trim molding and glass container, bathroom ceiling panel joiner, PVC ceiling trim/magar, PVC angle joiner, wallpaper base corner, aluminum ceiling trim and angles, aluminum joiner, ceiling looper, glue, deck hanging bracket, spandrel, soundproofing sheet and partitions, soundproofing panels, rock wool, OA floors, steel flooring material, insulation panel, lead board, royal stud, helmet, hangall, picture rail, welding machine, LVL, nonkiriko, and machine tools. It also provides exterior products, such as carports, sheds, fences, and stone materials to house builders and exterior construction companies; and water-based glass shatterproof coating, LED, non-flammable lightweight ceiling, seismic isolation and control system, and flood control solutions. In addition, the company offers housing and environment-related products, including colored steel sheets, solar power roofing, ALC metal fittings and auxiliary materials, and ceramic building material fittings and auxiliary materials, as well as architectural hardware, welded wire mesh, and iron wire products. Further, it provides metal siding, rain gutters, sandwich panels, sheet metal tools, galvalume steel roofing and exterior wall molding; ceiling lighting fixtures, industrial pressure fan, battery storage, drill screws, polycarbonate corrugated sheet, sheet metal mounting hardware, metal joiner, rooftop ventilation fan, cutting wheel; nails, screws, breathable sheet, anchor bolts, bicycle rack, nameplate, binding wire, grating; and annealed wire products. Hatsuho Shouji Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.
business_summary_ko: 하츠호쇼지(주) 일본에서 철강 및 건설자재를 거래하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 강철 천장 프레임, 강철 벽 베이스, 석고보드, 유리솜 및 주거용 단열재뿐만 아니라 천장, 불연성 보드, 암면 흡음 패널, 비스, 서스펜션 볼트, 천장 액세스 및 바닥 밑 검사 해치, 트림 몰딩 및 유리 용기, 욕실 천장 패널 조이너, PVC 천장 트림/마가, PVC 앵글 조이너, 벽지 베이스 코너, 알루미늄 천장 트림 및 앵글, 알루미늄 조이너, 천장 루퍼, 접착제, 데크 행잉 등 내부 건축 자재를 제공합니다. 브라켓, 스팬드럴, 방음시트 및 칸막이, 방음판, 암면, OA 바닥재, 철재바닥재, 단열판, 납판, 로얄스터드, 헬멧, 행걸, 픽처레일, 용접기, LVL, 논키리코, 공작기계 등 또한 주택 건축업자와 외장 건설 회사에 간이 차고, 창고, 울타리, 석재 등의 외장 제품을 제공합니다. 수성 유리 비산 방지 코팅, LED, 불연성 경량 천장, 면진 및 제어 시스템, 홍수 제어 솔루션. 또한 회사는 주거 및 환경을 제공합니다.
